item.title: Netanyahu claims 'historic achievements' in Iran war: 'We made a huge change here'
item.description: Netanyahu says Israel struck nuclear sites, missile systems and senior scientists, weakening Iran’s leadership and infrastructure, while warning campaign is ongoing and Tehran still retains missile capabilities despite setbacks

item.title: IDF steps up West Bank ops to contain terror threat amid tension between extremist Jews and Palestinians
item.description: As Israel maintains a ceasefire with Iran and continues operations in southern Lebanon, the IDF ramps up activity in the West Bank, carrying out more than 6,600 operations and arresting over 550 suspects to prevent escalation

item.title: Trump’s ‘chess game’ and Israel’s preparations: ‘The goal is strong pressure on Iran’

item.title: קלוד תחת אש: טראמפ רוצה לזרוק, אבל הצבא חייב אותו
